verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Deployments, a containers-as-a-service offering for running container images and serving ML models. That is the product's own managed way to deploy code without hand-managing VMs. However, nothing in the evidence shows autoscaling, scale-to-zero, or serverless GPU billing. Machine auto-shutdown only stops an idle VM after one hour to one week, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling of Deployment replicas, scale-to-zero behavior, GPU-backed serverless workers, per-request or idle billing semantics, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances

citations.quote: Deployments are containers-as-a-service that let you run container images and serve machine learning models.
